about: Style words: how each one shifts a box's colour and finish. The finish is guidance for the model. The colour shift is applied by code (grounding.apply_style) to the colour the model picks: in testing on dev sentences, qwen3:8b couldn't do the hex arithmetic itself (with example hex values it copied the example, without them it didn't shift at all). lightness and saturation are shifts in HLS: a negative value scales towards 0 (-0.3 = 30% darker), a positive value moves that share of the way towards 1 (+0.3 = 30% of the way to white / full saturation). Matched by grounding.py on whole words.

luxury.finish: matte 0.7-0.85, or high-gloss 0.03-0.08 if gloss is asked for; avoid the in-between
